name: Iniobong
tagline: Building AI systems that monitor water and land from space.

intro: I'm Iniobong Benson, a geospatial analyst and earth observation specialist pursuing a PhD at Southern Illinois University, Carbondale. I build GeoAI and earth-observation products, working mainly in remote sensing and hydrological modelling. I also founded and host Geospatially Africa, a podcast about geospatial work across the continent.
university: University of Tartu & ITC, University of Twente
description: Geospatial analyst and earth observation specialist with an Erasmus+ MSc, specialising in remote sensing, hydrological modelling, and GeoAI. Founder and host of the Geospatially Africa podcast.

news.text: Began my PhD in Environmental Resources & Policy at Southern Illinois University, Carbondale.
Completed the GEM Erasmus+ MSc; thesis introduced the GHDI multivariate drought index for the Greater Horn of Africa.
Research internship at Deltares (Delft) — a validation framework for Delft3D FM ocean models.
Founded and began hosting the Geospatially Africa podcast.
